scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Have you finished hunting the 50 Mantis?
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究员]
你猎杀够50只螳螂了吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: I want to quit
scripts.translation: 我想放弃

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Hmm, I don't think you've hunted 50 yet.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究员]
嗯，你好像还没猎杀够50只。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Remember, I need help hunting Mantis so go and hunt 50 of them.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究员]
记住，我需要你帮忙猎杀螳螂，去杀够50只吧。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Are you sure that you want to stop hunting?
Any progress that you've made will be erased
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究员]
确定要放弃狩猎吗？
目前的任务进度都会清除。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Ok then, well come back here if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究员]
好吧，改变主意了就回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Please kill 50 Mantis in order to make this a Place were people can go to and gather Experience.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究员]
请猎杀50只螳螂，好让大家能在这里练级。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Amazing, you did that with speed.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究员]
真厉害，这么快就完成了！

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Oh great!
You are here to help me right?
If not, i don't know what to do with the Monsters in this Place!
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究员]
太好了！
你是来帮我的吧？
不然真不知道该拿这里的魔物怎么办！

scripts.text: Sure
scripts.translation: 当然

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Great! I knew the moment i saw you that i can count on you!
I need you to reduce the Amount of Monsters which are currently rampaging on this Map!
There are to many Mantis around, which makes it impossible for the lower level players to gain good experience here.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究员]
太好了，一看你就知道靠得住！
帮我减少这张地图上肆虐的魔物吧！
螳螂实在太多，低等级玩家根本没法在这里好好练级。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
So, would you still like to help me?
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究员]
那么，你还愿意帮我吗？

scripts.text: Sure
scripts.translation: 当然

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Thank you for your great help with the Mantis!
Currently the Situation is stable and i'm not in need of your help anymore to kill them.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究员]
谢谢你帮忙对付螳螂！
目前情况已经稳定，暂时不用再帮忙猎杀了。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Kill 50 of those Mantis and let me know when you're done. I will reward you for your efforts.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究员]
去猎杀50只螳螂，完成后回来告诉我。
我会给你报酬。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
If you change your mind, please come back.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究员]
改变主意了就回来找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
If you change your mind, please come back.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究员]
改变主意了就回来找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Oh boy, Oh boy!
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究员]
天哪，天哪！

scripts.text:
[Mantis Researcher]
Sorry I can't talk right now I am in a world of pain here, these darn Mantis are going to kill me.
scripts.translation:
[螳螂研究员]
抱歉，顾不上说话了，我正受苦呢，这些该死的螳螂快把我逼死了。
